title: In-house Development Infra & Publishing Standardization
role: Standardized publishing, improved shared UI structure, and wrote development guides
introduction: I standardized folder structure, component naming, SCSS, API handling, and localization across projects. I also wrote example pages, style guides, and development documentation for the in-house framework.
myWorks: Standardized buttons, forms, selects, date pickers, progress, charts, grids, LNB, and layouts
Defined reusable conventions for naming, folder structure, API integration, and i18n for new projects
Established SCSS tokens, BEM naming, and component-level style management
Built and documented production-ready example pages and a style guide
achievements: Created a foundation for quickly applying base layouts, components, and the style guide on new projects
Unified scattered UI structures into a shared baseline for more efficient publishing–frontend collaboration
